_comment: Row-6 per-sample startup-ladder stage, decision rung RREF 71k (issue #244 AC 4c). Rung
picked from the deterministic evidence: ladder map x3..x4 bracket the 3.0 floor; the
203.2 uA from the S2 units' vte_avg, I_rung from each probe's vte_avg, both over RTE 2k).
71k is the strongest starvation whose measured nominal equivalent still clears the 3.0
floor, so a sustaining die CERTIFIES >= 3.0; 69k (2.980 < 3.0) would grade the campaign
yield ~0 by estimator construction. Nominal die sustains the criterion at 71k (vdiff
late pk-pk 0.144 V >= 0.1 V). The known-bad control body at this exact rung
(request-rung-pick-knownbad71k: pk-pk 6.3e-4 V). Vctrl 1.65 V, the pilot ladder's
convention. Same seed/scope contract as S1/S2: sample k is the same die as the S2
Vctrl=1.65 point, whose vte_avg is that die's nominal I_tail. Oscillation criterion:
t_cross_1 and t_cross_11 both present AND vdiff peak-to-peak over 15-20 ns >= 0.1 V.
engine_version 47 is the fail-closed post-run pin; the body carries selft=0 (documented
ngspice-47 VBIC self-heating deviation, run record 20261115-*).

measurements.name: t_cross_1
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_1 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=1 TD=10n

measurements.name: t_cross_11
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_11 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=11 TD=10n

measurements.name: vdiff_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_max MAX v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_late_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_late_max MAX v(vdiff) FROM=15n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_late_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_late_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=15n TO=20n

measurements.name: isup_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran isup_avg AVG i(vsup) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vtail_avg

measurements.name: vte_avg
